identificationModule.briefTitle: Hetrombopag for the Treatment of Chemotherapy-Induced Thrombocytopenia in Adults With Solid Tumors.
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase 3 Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Hetrombopag for the Treatment of Chemotherapy-induced Thrombocytopenia in Adults With Solid Tumors.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of current study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of hetrombopag for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in patients with solid tumors.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration from the commencement of treatment to a platelet count ≥100×109/L;
Proportion of subjects who could complete chemotherapy without dose modification and rescue therapy and;
Proportion of subjects without serious bleeding events;
Number of adverse events (AEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs)

locations.facility: Hematology Tumor Research Center of Harbin First Hospital
